field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: An empty model roster prevents a false claim of current LLM inference.
field_principles.acceptance_gates: Readiness, evidence authority and scientific benefit remain separate claims.
field_principles.actual_wrapper_path: Record real cascade factory, policy class, choose_action and is_done call counts.
field_principles.adapter_withheld: The shared isolation context denies game recipes, routes and cached per-game transitions.
field_principles.adversarial_findings: Retain all findings without changing validators or exemptions.
field_principles.arc_panel_ready_score: Require owned qualification, authenticated external evidence and all eight live receipts.
field_principles.censored_count: Count bounded episodes whose future outcome window remains unobserved; this may overlap completion.
field_principles.cited_upstream_artifacts: Name imported fields and their producer byte hashes.
field_principles.code_config_hashes: Bind wrapper adapters and CLI behavior to exact measured code.
field_principles.completed_count: Count terminal episodes with emitted receipts, including bounded action-limit runs.
field_principles.duration_s: Elapsed time is measured without padding, not inferred from action counts.
field_principles.emitted_receipt_count: Count actual terminal supervisor receipts, never fabricated completions.
field_principles.excluded_count: No intended episode is dropped after observing outcomes.
field_principles.experiment_id: Identify this producer, rather than a historical experiment.
field_principles.exposure_scope: Both installed public games have historical exposure and prior reproduction records.
field_principles.failed_count: Preserve every episode whose SDK or policy failed.
field_principles.field_principles: Explain each field's evidence limit and interpretation.
field_principles.flagged_adversarial: Owned failures and unresolved findings close readiness.
field_principles.frozen_panel: Metadata-only hash ordering fixes the complete paired schedule before measurement.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Name each missing or incorrect external operand with exact authority, path, hash and comparison.
field_principles.generalized_learning_benefit_score: No causal semantic benefit is established by numerical or wrapper parity.
field_principles.global_repository_health: Run the global suite once; its health cannot manufacture scientific benefit.
field_principles.headline_solve_credit: Already exposed public games receive zero headline credit.
field_principles.historical_model_provenance: Imported model calls are historical, never current calls.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A complete terminal disposition prevents retries of unchanged absence.
field_principles.independent_count: Games are independent units; seeds and arms never enlarge independent n.
field_principles.independent_generalization_score: An exposed two-game panel cannot establish hidden-game generalization.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Only real offline SDK transitions through the live policy supply observations.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: No LLM loads; the existing small common numeric head remains separate.
field_principles.intended_count: The fixed experiment contains exactly eight intended episodes.
field_principles.llm_invocation_count: No current LLM invocation occurs on this guarded substrate.
field_principles.milestone: Separate V722 execution from preserved V721 evidence.
field_principles.model_invocation_counts: Tripwires prevent LLM loading and generation before either occurs.
field_principles.model_tripwire_passed: All recorded episode guards must remain clear of attempted model paths.
field_principles.per_game_results: Keep per-game, seed and arm action costs and redirect outcomes.
field_principles.phase_spans: Monotonic boundaries distinguish observation costs from validation and repository health.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Measure authority, input bytes, private disk scratch, tools, memory and time budget before collection.
field_principles.random_seed: Reset fresh actual environments with paired seeds11 and22.
field_principles.raw_shard_hashes: Cold replay rejects changed primitive frames, action hashes, snapshots and logs.
field_principles.registry_precheck: Disclose prior exposed levels and full clears before selecting outcomes.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Seal the complete primitive reduction operands.
field_principles.reproduction_evidence: Fresh paired environments disclose incidental transitions without new solve credit.
field_principles.required_checks_passed: Only frozen owned checks qualify execution; global health remains separate.
field_principles.rows: Retain every intended game, paired seed and arm, even without an observation.
field_principles.sample_size_budget: Freeze games, seeds, arm order, action cap, time cap and window before outcomes.
field_principles.solve_provenance: Any level transition comes from the actual live policy's self-discovery.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Authenticate every imported input without assuming future producers exist.
field_principles.supervisor_outcome_rows: Keep applied and shadow outcomes separate, including pending and censored windows.
field_principles.task_id: Bind the receipt to the authenticated task digest.
field_principles.terminal_validation_sidecar_path: Locate the unchanged-validator report bound to exact primary bytes.
field_principles.validation_receipts: Keep actual command vectors, exits, deadlines, durations and log hashes.
field_principles.verdict_class: Owned failures disqualify; external absence blocks; exposed comparisons cannot be positive.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Visible runtime observations supply no hidden evaluator truth.
field_principles.work_reference: Bind the primary to the exact primitive reduction manifest.

historical_model_provenance: Inherited generator pin only; zero current neural calls.
